dedupe_keys.name: taiwan industrial waste reporting statistics waste generated stored and sent to reuse own treatment contracted treatment or export by county industry and waste code monthly to yearly 2015 to 2025

description: These statistics trace the waste produced by Taiwan's regulated businesses from generation to its final handling, based on the waste manifests that businesses file online. They are published by the Ministry of Environment (MOENV) through its industrial waste reporting and management information system. Reports give, by county, industry class and waste code, the quantities generated and stored and the amounts sent to reuse, treated on site, handed to contracted or joint treatment facilities, or exported, with separate reports on key waste types and their treatment methods, actual exports and imports, the number of licensed clearance and treatment organisations and reuse organisations, recycled resources and the proper handling rate. Monthly, quarterly and yearly statistics from 2015 to 2025 are free and available to download as ODS or XLS files, with the yearly figures for the previous year added by the end of June. Caveats: the data cover businesses required to report, not household waste; tables are aggregates, not facility-level flows; and the MOENV open data declaration could not be read because of a bot check. Simulation uses: sizing treatment and landfill capacity for industrial and medical waste, modelling flows between counties and treatment routes, and estimating how losing a treatment route would build up stored waste. Related records: the US EPA RCRAInfo biennial report (data-epa-rcrainfo-biennial-report-hazardous-waste) and the Japanese municipal waste survey (data-japan-municipal-waste-treatment-survey).
